sections.heading: Online applications are now available for fire alarm licenses

blocks.text: We are now taking electronic applications for some fire alarm licenses through Sircon:
On Sircon, select “new insurance license.” For most licenses, an Applicant’s Employer Information form must be submitted with a license application.
Fire Alarm registration, license, and test information: Describes the different types of registrations and licenses, type of work permitted by each license, test requirements, and test references.
Guide to Obtaining a Registration or License Online: How to apply or renew for a registration or license using Sircon.

Test Information: This link takes you to the PSI web site. This company is contracted to administer the SFMO tests. Click on the Candidate Information Bulletin found on the testing page for additional information regarding fees, scheduling policies, scoring information, and FAQs.
Phone: 512-676-6800 (press 1) from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. weekdays. Email: FMLicensing@tdi.texas.gov
